faq.r: Complete your profile (level, technologies, goal), then browse the forum. Asking a question or answering one is the best way to join the community.

faq.q: How do I ask a question?
faq.r: Go to the forum, click “Ask a question”, write a precise title, describe your problem with the error message and add up to 5 tags. Similar questions are suggested before you publish.
+10 when your answer gets an upvote, +5 for your question, +15 when your answer is accepted. A downvote removes 2 points. Badges arrive at 50, 200 and 500 points.

faq.q: How do I mark an answer as accepted?
faq.r: On your question, click the check mark next to the answer that helped. The question becomes “solved”.

faq.q: How do I publish my project?
faq.r: In “Projects”, click “New project”, describe it and list the skills you are looking for.

faq.q: How do I join a project team?
faq.r: Open the project and click “Join” with a short message. The owner accepts or declines, and you get a notification.
On the project page: the board has three columns, to do, in progress and done. Only the owner and members can edit it.

faq.q: How do I find a mentor?
faq.r: In “Mentoring”, pick a mentor, explain why you are reaching out and send the request. You can have 3 pending requests.

faq.q: How do I become a mentor?
faq.r: In “Edit my profile”, add the goal “Offer mentoring”. You can support up to 5 people.

faq.mots: chat messages channel city stack private
faq.r: In “Messages”, join a technology or city channel, or write privately to a developer from their profile.

faq.q: How do I send a voice message?
faq.r: Press the microphone in the message area, speak, then send. Allow the microphone in your browser. The transcribed text appears under the audio when the service is on. The microphone requires a secure connection (https).

faq.q: How do I change the language?
faq.r: Use the FR / EN switch at the top right. Your choice is remembered.
Pages you already visited stay readable offline. You can install DevConnect on your phone from the browser menu (“Add to home screen”).
Click the bell at the top. You are notified of answers, votes, applications and mentoring requests.
You can sign in with email and password, with a code sent by email, or with GitHub. Check your email address and wait a few minutes if you tried several times.
Use the “Report” button on the question or answer. Administrators review reports.
